signIn.title: Sign in to Quizz

importErrors.badHeader: The header must name the columns type, question, option_1…option_8, correct and keep_order.

status.replaced: Replaced by a name correction on {date}

certificates.revoked: Certificate revoked. Its Verification Page now shows it as revoked, with the date but not the reason.

mine.intro: Prove your email with a one-time code to see every Certificate issued to it, on any Assessment.
mine.none: No Certificates were issued to this email.
mine.newName: Full name, as it should appear
mine.correctHint: This replaces the Certificate with a new one at a new link, emailed to you. The old link will say it was replaced.

mine.notCorrectable: Only a Valid Certificate can be corrected.
